opening.argument: The material promotes a Litecoin mining site through paid plans that display prices, daily-return figures, contract periods, and selection controls. The speaker claims viewers will earn “1.35 USD every single day for 30 days,” then instructs them to choose an option and recharge. The payment step is explicit: viewers are told to send 10 USDT to a displayed address, after which mining will supposedly start faster. An order screen shows a cryptocurrency payment destination and a waiting-for-payment status, while the records do not establish a completed transfer, actual returns, or the recipient of funds. Although the description calls the videos educational and conditions income on effort and time, those qualifications do not remove the paid-return solicitation.
